scope: Actual unauthenticated localhost HTTP and independent ZIP-byte verification. No account, session, cookie or credential was used or recorded. Original external pages and photographs were not fetched by this validation. A known source hash establishes saved-byte integrity, not independent source truth.

canonical_product_api.interpretation: Front/rear availability includes verified external publisher links. It is not a claim that all 55 rear photographs are locally hosted. Overall evidence spans can cross formats and price levels; missing years remain missing.

monthly_market_index.scope: Secondary median across surveyed city prices. Separate from retailer observations, transactions and one unchanged ABV; no primary raw CSV claim.

initial_scan.interpretation: The first unpaced concurrent listing was incomplete under the application rate controls. The complete scan above was paced below the configured 20 requests/second API limit; no isolation or rate control was changed. The initial exact rejection status was not retained, so no unverified status code is asserted here.

public_memento_http.http_sample_scope: One real public HTTP capsule from each of 6 kinds. All 1161 capsules independently hash-verified in the latest downloaded ZIP whose manifest matches this live snapshot; individual HTTP downloads of every capsule were avoided.

committed_metadata_memento_zip.link_scope: Every index-to-capsule link is checked inside the ZIP. The immutable offline snapshot can differ from the current live manifest; public HTTP capsule downloads intentionally expose only current manifest members.

prior_unmodified_data_checks_retained.reason: The final Memento publication-policy change affects source capsule selection. These previously validated application data checks are retained; this final pass rechecks the rebuilt artifacts and current Memento HTTP endpoints.
